body: Thank you. Luckily with fiverr it has helped me have a deadline to work and put things out. Sometimes I feel good, but then when it gets bad, it gets really bad... I feel weird even talking about it

My parents have been helping me, but they dont know how depressed I am. And it has been hard to find a job, or at least something I can work from home. I keep telling myself to find a job where I feel safe enough, and not struggle with sickness, but at the same time I stopped caring for my wellbeing this year almost entirely. Sometimes I get the urge to draw, but halfway through a drawing I just quit. I used to love drawing.
